title: Groww vs Zerodha: Charges, Features and Which Is Better in 2026
summary: Zerodha charges ₹0 on delivery and Groww charges ₹0 AMC. See which costs less for how you trade, with real cost examples, AMC exemptions and API pricing.
body_markdown:
Groww and Zerodha are SEBI-registered discount brokers. Groww charges zero account maintenance charges (AMC), while Zerodha charges zero brokerage on equity delivery. Both charge ₹20 per executed options order.


Groww is India’s largest broker by NSE active clients, with about 1.34 crore in September 2026. Zerodha is second, with about 67.9 lakh.


**Quick answer:** Zerodha usually costs less if you trade often, especially for delivery and small intraday orders. Groww usually costs less if you place only a few orders a year and your Zerodha account would pay the standard AMC. Options brokerage is the same at both.


*Disclosure: This comparison uses each broker’s published pricing and documentation.*

## Groww vs Zerodha Charges: Which Costs Less?

## Intraday Trading: “Both Charge ₹20” Misses the Difference


On a ₹10,000 intraday order, Groww charges ₹10 (0.1%) and Zerodha charges ₹3 (0.03%). Since a full trade has an entry and an exit, the round trip costs ₹20 at Groww and ₹6 at Zerodha.


Groww reaches its ₹20 cap on orders of ₹20,000 and above, while Zerodha reaches it only from about ₹66,700. Between those two sizes, Zerodha costs less per order.

## F&O Trading: Count Your Orders, Not the Rate


Options brokerage is ₹20 per executed order at both brokers, so your order count decides the cost. A two-leg spread that you open and later close needs four orders, which means ₹80 in brokerage before GST at either broker. Every adjustment adds more.


Before placing a multi-leg trade:


-


Check strikes and premiums on the[Nifty option chain](https://algotest.in/nifty-option-chain) .


-


Replay how a similar position behaved on past trading days with the[Option Simulator](https://algotest.in/feature/simulator?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=seo&utm_campaign=simulator&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=seo&utm_campaign=simulator) .


-


Estimate the margin you need on the[margin calculator](https://algotest.in/margin-calculator) , and confirm it with your broker.


#### Charges That Are Easy to Miss


-


Groww charges 1% brokerage, with no cap, on equity orders funded through UPI Mandate balance. Adding money to your Groww balance normally avoids this.


-


Groww charges ₹50 + GST per position if you don’t close intraday positions by 3:20 PM.


-


Zerodha charges ₹50 per order placed through its dealer, including auto square-off orders.


-


Both brokers charge for pledging, and both charge interest on any debit balance in your trading account.

## Which Is Better for Long-Term Investing and Mutual Funds?


For regular delivery buying, Zerodha has the brokerage advantage. For a few purchases a year, compare that saving with the AMC your Zerodha account would actually pay.


Both brokers offer direct mutual funds with no distributor commission. The bigger difference is how your units are held:


-


Zerodha Coin holds mutual fund units in your demat account.


-


Groww holds new mutual fund purchases in demat form by default, but you can opt out and keep them in an AMC folio, also called a Statement of Account (SoA).


-


Demat holding keeps stocks and funds in one place and lets you[pledge units for trading margin](https://algotest.in/blog/what-is-margin-pledge-your-complete-guide/) .


-


SoA holding supports SWP (Systematic Withdrawal Plan) and STP (Systematic Transfer Plan), which are not available in demat mode.


If you move an existing portfolio, transfer the units rather than selling and buying again, which can trigger tax and exit loads.

## Groww App vs Zerodha Kite: Which Is Better for Trading?


Zerodha splits its tools by purpose, while Groww keeps most products in one app.


**Zerodha**


-


Kite is the trading platform on web and mobile.


-


Coin handles mutual funds, and Console holds reports, P&L and tax statements.


-


Varsity is Zerodha’s free learning library on markets, F&O and taxes.


**Groww**


-


The Groww app combines stocks, ETFs, IPOs, F&O and mutual funds.


-


Groww Terminal puts charts, option chains, orders and positions in one workspace.


-


915 Terminal adds a separate interface for active traders.


Feature lists don’t show reliability. Before choosing, check whether you can comfortably:


-


Place, modify and cancel the order types you use.


-


Track open positions and spot rejected orders quickly.


-


Find contract notes, charges and realised P&L.


-


Reach support, and use a backup way to place orders if the app has a problem.

### FAQs


#### Is Groww completely free?


Groww charges nothing for account opening or maintenance. Stock and F&O trades still carry brokerage and statutory charges, and some optional services cost extra.


#### Does Zerodha charge AMC?


It depends on your account. Standard individual accounts pay ₹300 + GST a year. New primary accounts opened on or after 1 June 2026 pay nothing in the first year. Single-demat BSDA accounts pay ₹0 up to ₹4 lakh in holdings and ₹100 + GST between ₹4 lakh and ₹10 lakh.


#### What are the disadvantages of Groww compared with Zerodha?


Groww charges brokerage on delivery trades and a higher percentage on small intraday orders. Its DP charge on selling is also higher, and orders funded through UPI Mandate balance carry 1% brokerage.


#### What are the disadvantages of Zerodha compared with Groww?


Standard Zerodha accounts pay ₹300 + GST in AMC each year after any waiver. Investors who want stocks and mutual funds in one app may find switching between Kite and Coin less convenient.


#### Which is bigger, Zerodha or Groww?


Groww is bigger by active clients. In September 2026, it had about 1.34 crore NSE active clients, a 29.16% market share, while Zerodha had about 67.9 lakh, or 14.73%. An active client is someone who traded at least once in the past year.


#### Which is safer, Groww or Zerodha?


Both operate through SEBI-registered broking entities, and your shares sit in your own demat account with the depository. Registration does not remove market losses, outages or operational risk, so check your monthly depository statements and know each broker’s grievance process.


#### Can I invest in US stocks through Groww or Zerodha?


As of 19 October 2026, Zerodha offers US stocks and ETFs in public beta on Kite through GIFT City. Groww is preparing to relaunch US stock investing through GIFT City, so check availability in the app.


#### Can I use Groww or Zerodha for algo trading?


Yes. Both offer trading APIs, and both connect with AlgoTest. Speed is only one factor when choosing a broker for algos, as explained in[Broker Speedtest by AlgoTest](https://algotest.in/blog/broker-speedtest-algotest/) .


#### Can I have accounts with both Groww and Zerodha?


Yes. Keep in mind the extra record-keeping, and that a second demat account can affect Zerodha BSDA eligibility.
